At 8.2 the higher sounds happen 'on account of the tension'. Ptolemy ultimately reduces density and thinness to tension.

verify.summary:
I checked all 47 findings in decided-2.json: 39 are confirmed and 8 corrected. None is wrong, not found, or unopenable; only one cited URL (the BBAW CLD page for κανών, Q14-08) was unreachable, and I checked the same LSJ text on lsj.gr instead. Most sources were checked against primary texts: Jan's Musici scriptores Graeci (archive.org OCR and page images, First1KGreek), Hiller's Theon, LSJ on Scaife and lsj.gr, DGE, Bailly, Smyth, CGCG, the Cambridge Greek Lexicon preview, Solomon's Ptolemy and Monro.

The corrections:
- **Q12-01:** Bacchius' definition of σύστημα is at Jan p. 292.18–19, not p. 293.
- **Q12-06 and Q14-06:** Cleonides describes the Greater Perfect System in §10, not §9, both in Strunk/attalus and in Jan pp. 200–201.
- **Q13-01:** Jan p. 244.2 prints κοιλιώσεις, not κοιλιώδεις; the finding copied an OCR error, and the page image shows κοιλιώσεις.
- **Q13-04:** Pl. Sph. 248d is the adjectival singular ('partaking of both'), not the adverbial ἀμφότερον τε…καί. DGE heads the singular 'uno y otro / uno u otro' and the Cambridge Greek Lexicon gives 'each, either (of two)', so 'no sense one of two' needs qualifying. No source gives 'the other'.
- **Q14-07:** Monro's §18 diagram shows the combined unmodulating system (18 names), not the Greater System alone.

Small slips in otherwise confirmed findings:
- Line numbers are off by one in Q12-09 (interval definition at 179.11–12) and in Q12-02 (the quoted words are on p. 333.10–11).
- In Q14-02 the Basel print spells it 'περάτος', while the manuscripts have 'πέρατος'.
- In Q12-08 the LSJ musical sense is numbered 6; the entry has no Roman I.

Things worth knowing that do not change a verdict:
- **Q14-01/Q14-03:** In Theon p. 64.5 the moderns' πεντεκαιδεκάχορδον is said to span three octaves and a tone, not a double octave.
- **Q10-13:** Cleonides uses the pair ἑξῆς / καθ' ὑπερβατόν for systems (Jan p. 193.6–7 and 199.8–10).
- **Q10-01/Q10-03:** DGE cites Anon. Bellerm. 4 only with 'cf.'. I could not check the Anonymus text itself.
- **Q13-08:** This was marked 'from memory'; it is now confirmed from Solomon's translation of Ptolemy's Harmonics 1.3 (Düring 7.22–9.2).
